name: Hockey stick
definition: long-shafted stick with a flat blade, made to carry and shoot the puck in ice hockey; flex, kick point, blade pattern and hand are attributes.
notes: Pure Hockey and Hockey Monkey sell composite, wood and goalie sticks as a category; goalie stick is a variant.

name: Hockey helmet
definition: hard-shell helmet with chin strap made for ice hockey; sold alone or as a combo with a cage.
notes: Hockey Monkey filters Helmet Only vs With Facecage; certification HECC/CSA is an attribute.

name: Hockey cage or visor
definition: face cage or clear shield that clips to a hockey helmet.
notes: Hockey Monkey lists Cages & Shields (30 items) as its own category beside helmets.

name: Hockey shoulder pads
definition: padded shoulder, chest and upper-arm protector worn under the jersey in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Hockey category with senior to youth divisions.

name: Hockey elbow pads
definition: padded elbow and forearm guard worn in ice hockey.

name: Hockey gloves
definition: padded glove with a segmented cuff made for skaters in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Hockey category, 102 results; goalie gloves are the catcher and blocker.

name: Hockey pants
definition: padded pants or girdle with shell worn over the hips and thighs in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Hockey sells pants, girdles and pant shells separately; shells are a variant.

name: Goalie leg pads
definition: pair of large rigid-faced pads strapped over the goalie shins and knees in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Goalie category; width limited to 11 inches by regulation (Goalie Monkey guide).

name: Goalie blocker
definition: rectangular pad on the goalie stick hand, used to deflect shots and hold the stick.
notes: Pure Goalie category; Goalie Monkey calls it worn on the dominant hand.

name: Goalie catcher
definition: large pocketed glove on the goalie non-stick hand, made to catch the puck.
notes: Pure Goalie sells it as catch glove; also called catcher by Goalie Monkey.

name: Goalie mask
definition: face mask or helmet-cage worn by the goalie in ice hockey.
notes: Pure Goalie category (28 masks); position-specific, player helmets will not suffice.

name: Hockey puck
definition: vulcanised rubber disc struck in ice hockey; mini and training pucks are variants.
notes: Pure Hockey lists Ice Hockey Pucks (28) and Bulk Pucks as categories.

name: Hockey goal
definition: steel-framed goal with netting set on the ice or floor for ice or street hockey; replacement net is a part.
notes: Pure Hockey lists Goals (16) and Replacement Nets; Hockey Monkey lists Full Size Goals.

name: Field hockey stick
definition: curved composite or wood stick with a hooked head, made for field hockey.
notes: Decathlon UK Field Hockey > Hockey Sticks; shops sell it apart from ice hockey sticks (leaf is ice hockey, sport differs).

name: Bandy stick
definition: light slim stick with a long narrow blade, made for bandy.
notes: Sportimex lists CCM Bandy Stick SR P4 under Ice Hockey > Sticks; page returned only breadcrumb and title.
